He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)

Farkas says passing tougher Russia sanctions would be the best tribute to Graham and could put meaningful pressure on Moscow by cutting into its oil revenue. She also says the US and Israel are "not fully aligned" on Iran, arguing that Washington is focused on reopening the Strait of Hormuz while Israel seeks to weaken Iran more permanently. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

Bloomberg News Jerusalem Reporter Dan Williams discussed the complex and often tense relationship between Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and US President Donald Trump during their recent meeting at the White House. Williams noted that while past tensions have not derailed their relationship, the current talks are shrouded in strategic ambiguity, with speculation about whether the leaders are negotiating a shift in Israel's stance on the Iran conflict or exploring renewed cooperation.  He speaks with Joe Mathieu on the early edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power."
  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia’s CEO Jensen Huang Defends Open-Weight AI Models
title_cn: Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋捍卫开放权重人工智能模型
summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang defended open-weight artificial intelligence systems as crucial to the nascent AI industry, sending a cautionary message to officials in Washington who are debating how to respond to a surprise breakthrough from Chinese startup Moonshot.

title: Burnham Vows to Tackle UK’s Expensive Social Care Problems
title_cn: 伯纳姆誓言解决英国昂贵的社会关怀问题
summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham will meet opposition party leaders on Wednesday to kickstart his effort to reform the UK’s creaking social care system.

title: Militias in Iraq Attack Saudi Oil Facilities for a Second Day
title_cn: 伊拉克民兵连续第二天袭击沙特石油设施
summary: Iran-backed militias in Iraq fired drones at oil facilities in Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Region for the second day in a row, piling pressure on the kingdom, which is grappling with a maritime blockade limiting its crude oil shipments.
